function: Excluded (system): over-the-air federated distillation, an area 7 work whose link has a single-antenna PS and single-antenna WDs and no RIS (p. 2).
notes: System, p. 2: "an FD system [6] consisting of a single-antenna PS and M single-antenna WDs"; no RIS anywhere in the paper. The work is area 7: devices send soft predictions by over-the-air computation and the paper designs the closed-form transceiver and number of rounds (pp. 3-4). So the earlier codes do not apply: no_learning (the model trained across devices is learned), above_phy, and function (aggregation is over the air). Simulations on MNIST are reported (pp. 4-5). The PDF is arXiv:2508.06557v1 and has the same title and authors as the DOI.
